nodes.description: Private constant 86400 used to convert day counts to seconds and to floor timestamps to day boundaries.
Immutable IERC20 token held in timelock; target of safeTransfer calls.
Immutable beneficiary address receiving released tokens.
Immutable start timestamp of the release period (day-aligned).
Mutable end timestamp of the release period; reset on terminate().
Mutable total benefit amount; reduced on terminate().
Tracks amount already withdrawn by the beneficiary.
Flag indicating the timelock contract has been terminated.
Owner address from Ownable; controls terminate/ownership functions.
SupervisedTimelock constructor: sets token, beneficiary, release window (day-aligned), total benefit and flags; reverts if release end is in the past.
View getter returning the held IERC20 token.
View getter returning the beneficiary address.
View getter returning the total benefit.
Computes currently released amount as a linear function of elapsed days; depends on block.timestamp.
Returns totalBenefit minus releasedBalance().
View getter returning the withdrawn balance.
Withdraws the delta between released and already withdrawn tokens to the beneficiary via safeTransfer.
Owner-only: locks total benefit to released amount, ends the timelock, and transfers the residual balance to the owner.
Modifier restricting execution to the current owner.
Modifier requiring the contract not yet terminated.
Context helper returning msg.sender.
Private function writing the new owner into _owner and emitting OwnershipTransferred.
Owner-only transfer of ownership; validates non-zero new owner then calls _setOwner.
Owner-only renouncement: sets owner to address(0) via _setOwner.
View getter returning the current owner.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership checks and initialization.
Miner-influenceable timestamp driving release math and terminate() end-time reset.
External token safeTransfer call inside withdraw() executed after state update; potential reentrancy entry point.
External token safeTransfer of residual balance to owner inside terminate(); potential reentrancy entry point.
Arithmetic in releasedBalance(): totalBenefit * passedDays / totalDays plus day divisions.
Arithmetic in terminate(): _totalBenefit = releasedBalance() and balance minus (totalBenefit - withdrawedBalance) subtraction.
Constructor parameter token_ assigned to _token.
Constructor parameter beneficiary_ assigned to _beneficiary.
Constructor parameter releaseStartTime_ day-aligned and stored.
Constructor parameter daysOfTimelock_ multiplied by SECONDS_OF_A_DAY.
Constructor parameter totalBenefit_ assigned to _totalBenefit.
newOwner argument of transferOwnership().
newOwner argument of _setOwner().
Local variable caching the previous owner before overwrite.
Local amount = releasedBalance() - _withdrawedBalance in withdraw().
Local residual balance transferred to owner in terminate().
Local passed days since release start in releasedBalance().
Local total days of the release window in releasedBalance().

edges.reason: msg.sender is returned by the Context._msgSender() helper.

Constructor establishes the initial owner via _setOwner.
onlyOwner reads owner() to compare against the caller.
isNotTerminated reads _isTerminated to gate execution.
releasedBalance() branches and computes directly on block.timestamp.
Constructor requires _releaseEndTime > block.timestamp.
terminate() resets _releaseEndTime from block.timestamp.
_releaseStartTime is used in releasedBalance() time math.
_releaseEndTime bounds the releasedBalance() calculation.
_totalBenefit is multiplied/divided in releasedBalance().
releasedBalance() result feeds the multiplication/division arithmetic.
passedDays participates in the released math.
totalDays is the divisor in the released math.

releasedBalance() is subtracted in unreleasedBalance().

terminate() performs subtraction arithmetic on state balances.

terminate() calls releasedBalance() to fix the locked benefit.

_token is the call target of the external safeTransfer in terminate().
Computed residual amount is passed to the external transfer in terminate().
owner() is evaluated as the recipient of the external transfer in terminate().
